items.title: Buckingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Monk' ('Thanks, Monk.'), not the person to judge.

ctx.x: So Mr. Buckingham, welcome back to Hamilton College.
You just caused a fire drill. But I was very interested in some of the things you were talking about in the country music class, and it made me think of — we posted your Part 1 interview.
